Question: How many 1-star reviews were given for orders that were canceled?
text:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS one_star_canceled_reviews
FROM   reviews   AS r
JOIN   orders    AS o
       ON r.order_id = o.id
WHERE  r.rating = 1                -- 1‑star review
  AND  o.status = 'canceled';     -- order was cancelled
```
